Firebase Auth / Identity Platform

Billing unit: MAU — Firebase Authentication with Identity Platform bills Google Cloud Identity Platform rates: Tier 1 (email, phone, anonymous, social) per MAU in volume bands; Tier 2 (SAML/OIDC) per federated MAU; phone/MFA per SMS sent. firebase.google.com/pricing lists no cost up to 50K MAUs and 50 SAML/OIDC MAUs, then Google Cloud pricing. Source: cloud.google.com/identity-platform/pricing, checked 2026-10-31. Visit Firebase Auth / Identity Platform

Answer · Firebase Auth / Identity Platform cost by MAU (no SSO)

10k users: $0/mo on Pay as you go · 50k users: $0/mo on Pay as you go · 100k users: $275/mo on Pay as you go.

  • 1k users · no SSO: Pay as you go lists $0/mo: tie at $0 with 10 other plans.
  • 10k users · 1 SSO: Pay as you go at $2.25/mo ranks #4 (tied) of 19, $27/yr more than Auth0 Free (assumes 1 customer organization per SSO connection) (assumes 200 SSO users per connection; at 1,000 per connection $14.25/mo, #4 of 19; at 2,000 per connection $29.25/mo, #5 of 19).
  • 50k users · 5 SSO: Pay as you go at $14.25/mo is the cheapest of 13 (assumes 200 SSO users per connection; at 1,000 per connection $74.25/mo, #1 of 13; at 2,000 per connection $149.25/mo, #1 of 13).
  • 100k users · 10 SSO: Pay as you go at $304.25/mo ranks #2 of 13, $3,000/yr more than Supabase Auth Pro (platform) (assumes 200 SSO users per connection; at 1,000 per connection $424.25/mo, #2 of 13; at 2,000 per connection $574.25/mo, #3 of 13).

As of 2026-10-31, from 25 verified plan rows. SSO users: Amazon Cognito, Supabase Auth and Firebase Auth / Identity Platform bill SAML/OIDC per SSO user, not per connection (first 50 free, then $0.015 per SSO user a month). Their SSO results here assume 200 SSO users per connection (5 connections = 1,000 SSO users). See how 1,000 or 2,000 per connection changes the result or set your own. B2B: every SSO result assumes 1 customer organization per SSO connection (members = its SSO users, 200 by default). Published org caps and fees are applied, e.g. Clerk’s $100/mo B2B Authentication add-on above 20 members or 100 orgs, Auth0 Free’s 5-org cap, Descope $1/tenant over 35; plans over a cap are left out. No cost up to 50k MAU (email, phone, anonymous, social), then $0.0055/MAU to 100k, $0.0046 to 1M, $0.0032 to 10M, $0.0025 above. SAML/OIDC: 50 MAU free then $0.015/MAU. SMS (phone sign-in and MFA) billed per message by region (US $0.01); first 10 SMS a day not billed. Sources: cloud.google.com/identity-platform/pricing and firebase.google.com/pricing.
